8bd9adde87e4bf76.description: **** AB O U T S U P E R N OVA**** Supernova is India's largest consumer AI startup, building AI products that help the world communicate. Our products have reached 3 crore+ users and the business has grown to about $17 million in ARR. Our core product is an AI-powered spoken English app built for people who grew up speaking Indian languages like Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi and more. We have 3M paid learners. We also build Superflow, an AI communication utility that helps people express themselves faster. **T H E R O L E** You'll own the learning experience and curriculum for our full product. Our learning track is built around comprehension and speaking activities, taught by an AI tutor. Your job is to make learners learn faster, stay longer, and tell their friends. This is not just a content role. Because the teaching is done by AI, you'll treat the curriculum as a product and an AI system: understand the learner, define what good looks like, measure it, and improve it through constant experiments. **W H AT YO U ' L L O W N** Own the retention, revenue and learning outcome metrics. Design, run and see through experiments and learning features from start to finish. • Monitor how our learning tracks are performing: ratings, completion rates, where people drop off. •Study real learner conversations with the AI tutor to find where it fails, confuses people, or teaches the wrong thing. •Create evals (tests that check if the AI tutor is truly getting better, not just looking good on a few hand- picked examples). •Run A/B tests across prompts, models, lesson flows and AI tutor behaviour.• Work with engineering and data on prompts, guardrails and production quality, balancing learning quality with speed and cost. •When something looks off, debug funnels and data, go talk to users and solve the problem.• WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR **Prior EdTech experience is mandatory: 2–4 years of experience working with an EdTech company, online learning platform, digital education product or consumer learning app.** •Curriculum-to-product thinking: Ability to translate educational content and learning objectives into engaging, structured and measurable product experiences. •Content quality and instructional judgement: Ability to evaluate whether learning content is accurate, pedagogically sound, easy to understand and appropriate for the learner's proficiency level. •Data-driven curriculum improvement: Experience using learner feedback, performance data and experimentation to continuously improve curriculum quality and learning outcomes. •You've run experiments before. Define the variant, set the metric, read the results, decide what to do next. •You care about learning outcomes. You can tell when something in the curriculum is off without someone pointing it out. •Strong judgement on AI output. AI tutors rarely have one correct answer; you can tell what feels helpful, natural and accurate for a learner. •Independent with data. Basic SQL — you know which questions to ask and pull the data yourself. First-principles thinking. You break messy problems down, find the root cause, and form your own point of view. • Basic UI/UX sense. You can give feedback on a screen and know when something feels wrong. Some comfort with tech and vibe coding. We sometimes launch features directly with a PM building the first version. • You genuinely like talking to users. **Good to Have** Very fluent using AI tools in your own work to move faster. • Hands-on experience shipping AI / LLM-powered features. • Experience at a consumer app, edtech, or high-growth product company **HOW PRODUCT WORKS HERE ** Product at Supernova is not a coordination role. PMs understand users, get into the data themselves, and work closely with design and engineering until something meaningful ships. • Experimentation beats long debate. We've run 2,000 A/B tests in the last 2 years. • The metric must move. Shipping a feature is not the outcome. • Ownership over instructions. You'll usually get a problem, not a detailed spec. • Speed with judgement. Move quickly, but know which decisions need precision. • No politics. Clear thinking and results matter more than seniority or presentation. • **What you will get :** Direct ownership of key learning, retention and revenue metrics. • Millions of learners — enough scale to know whether your ideas actually work. • A steep education in building and monetising consumer AI products. • A flat team where your scope grows quickly when you show good judgement

8b7933161f1a38ed.description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.
Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.
Role Overview
The Data Quality Analyst focuses on data quality across Imagine’s data ecosystem. The role proactively monitors data from devices, programme systems and field sources, builds and improves the checks that catch problems early, and investigates issues raised across the organisation. Where an issue requires deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work, the role provides its findings and works with the relevant team member to resolve it. 
Imagine’s data covers learning activity from tablets in more than 1,500 schools, along with programme, operational and field data. Devices sync intermittently and sources don’t always agree, so checking data against what is happening in schools and in the field is central to the work.
The role reports to the Director of Analytics and works closely with the Data Scientist, who provides methodological support. It suits an analyst who enjoys tracing a problem back to its source and wants to keep developing in a small team. As they build context on Imagine’s data, the role takes on more ownership of the team’s data quality reporting and standards.
Key Responsibilities
The Data Analyst’s responsibilities fall into four pillars: data quality monitoring and improvement, data issue investigation, communicating findings, and analytical practice.
Data Quality Monitoring and Improvement 
The role takes a proactive approach to data quality, identifying risks and gaps before they affect reporting or decision-making. 

• Monitor the completeness, consistency and plausibility of data across Imagine’s sources, and identify issues independently.

• Design and implement data quality checks, and recommend where further checks or controls are needed across pipelines and source systems.

• Develop tooling and automated monitoring that make data quality issues visible, working with the Analytics Engineer on implementation within the platform.

• Reconcile figures across related sources and investigate discrepancies.

• Contribute to the team’s data quality reporting, rules and standards.

Data Issue Investigation 
The role is the Analytics Team’s first point of investigation when data issues are identified, whether through monitoring or raised by colleagues. 

• Investigate data issues and trace them to their root cause across source systems, pipelines and data models.

• Work with the Analytics Engineer, MEAL and country teams to resolve issues at source and confirm their resolution.

• Handle assigned data quality and data export requests from the Analytics Team’s request process.

• Document findings and hand over issues that require deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work to the relevant team member.

• Support the team’s data quality incident process by providing the evidence needed for decisions.

Communicating Findings

• Write concise summaries of data issues and investigations, covering the cause, the impact and the recommended action.

• Report on the state of data quality to the Analytics Team and, where appropriate, to the teams that own the source data.

• Use clear charts and tables to show the scope and impact of issues.

• State data limitations plainly, so that figures are not over-interpreted when shared further.

Analytical Practice
Analysis is only useful to a small team if others can check it, reuse it and build on it.

• Keep checks and analyses reproducible, using version-controlled code and notebooks that someone else could rerun and arrive at the same result.

• Follow the Analytics Team’s standards for code, documentation and data use, and contribute to improving them as the team grows.

• Use the team’s shared data models and agreed metric definitions as the starting point for analysis, and flag where they fall short rather than working around them quietly.

• Ask for review of methods and conclusions from the Data Scientist and Director of Analytics, and give constructive review on colleagues’ work in return.

• Build a working knowledge of Imagine’s data, programmes and operating contexts, so that analyses reflect how the programme actually runs on the ground.

• Handle sensitive data responsibly, in line with Imagine’s data governance and privacy policies.

Requirements
The qualifications below are grouped by importance. Core requirements are needed to do the role from the start. Strongly preferred skills shorten the time it takes to become effective with Imagine’s data. Advantageous experience adds value but is not expected.
Education
• A bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. 
Experience

• At least 3 years in a data analyst or closely related quantitative role.

• Experience monitoring, validating or reconciling data, and tracing issues back to their source.

• Experience working with imperfect real-world data, such as missing records, inconsistent sources or late-arriving data, and explaining how those issues affect a result.

• Experience building automated checks or reports that others rely on.

• Experience communicating findings in writing to non-technical readers.

• Experience working with remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.

• Experience in the non-profit, international development or social sector is an advantage but not a requirement.

Technical Skills: Core

• Strong SQL, including joins, aggregations and window functions across large tables.

• Proficiency in at least one key programming language (such as Python) for automation, data analysis, and reproducible research.

• Data profiling and validation techniques, including completeness, consistency and plausibility checks.

• Applied statistics for identifying anomalies, including distributions, outliers and trends.

• Clear data visualisation.

Technical Skills: Strongly Preferred

• Querying analytical or columnar databases such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.

• Data quality testing frameworks such as dbt tests, Great Expectations or Soda.

• Reproducible workflows using notebooks and Git.

Technical Skills: Advantageous

• An understanding of data pipelines and how a dbt-modelled data warehouse is structured.

• Education, programme monitoring or field survey data.

• Field data collection tools such as CommCare, ODK or KoboToolbox.

• BI tools such as Apache Superset, Metabase or Power BI.

• Spreadsheet tools for sharing data with stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits
Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.
Location
The Data Analyst must be based in Africa. The role will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK. 
This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. Join Collibra's Sales team as a Senior Account Executive, Financial Services - East Coast

Collibra is the Data Intelligence company, helping organizations maximize the value of their data through trusted, governed, and meaningful data access — empowering many of the world's leading financial institutions to scale data-driven decision-making while meeting the most demanding regulatory and compliance requirements.

As a Senior Account Executive within Collibra's Financial Services vertical, you will spearhead a premier portfolio of strategic East Coast accounts, ranging from global investment firms to some of the nation's largest commercial banking institutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and Financial Services leaders, navigating them through the complexities of data and AI governance to unlock a distinct competitive advantage. Your mission is to build brand authority and serve as a Data Intelligence visionary across the entire customer lifecycle, driving demand, accelerating adoption, and leading expansion efforts within a territory of top-tier incumbents and high-growth financial prospects.

Senior Account Executives, Financial Services at Collibra are responsible for

• Prospecting for net new FinServ accounts, greenfield building, and developing relationships with existing customers to maintain active deal pipeline and ideal quota coverage in your territory.

• Managing and creating demand for expansion on existing FinServ customers to widen the footprint of Collibra within these accounts.

• Managing complex deal cycles, from lead origination to stakeholder mapping, through negotiation to close and expansion.

• Successfully collaborating with customers, partners, and peers in a consultative sales process where you will identify value and ROI aligned to the specific data governance and compliance needs of financial institutions.

• Reliable, accurate forecasting, with Salesforce updates reflective of real-time activity.

You have

• At least 2–3 years of experience in Data Management, Data/AI Governance, or FinServ technology sales, with deep familiarity with the regulatory landscapes and data complexities inherent to the financial sector.

• A proven ability to originate and lead complex, value-based sales cycles, navigating multiple technical and business stakeholders to secure both net-new business and strategic expansions.

You are

• Composed and resourceful, remaining focused and effective in fast-paced, evolving environments.

8b587ff6fef60c35.description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

How You'll Make An Impact

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

What You'll Do

• Turn business goals into clear software requirements. 
• Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each. 
• Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy. 
• Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed. 
• Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch. 
• Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results. 
• Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models. 
• Rank feature requests from the development teams. 
• Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications. 
• Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs. 
• Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear. 
• Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity. 

What You'll Bring

• Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus. 
• Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models. 
• Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code. 
• Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them. 
• Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle. 
• Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management. 
• Structured approach and experience with agile methods. 
• History of working with development teams to get results. 
• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves. 
• Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization. 
• Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do. 
• Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Why Work for Us?

• We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth. 
• You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
• Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
• Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
• A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
• Recruitment referral bonus
• Work for a Great Place to Work®

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

 We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Who We Are 
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!
 
Your Team and Role
As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. 
 
Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/
 
About You 
• 
7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands
• 
Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems
• 
Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects
• 
Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on
• 
A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft
• 
Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system
• 
Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms
• 
Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales
• 
Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality
• 
Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale 
• 
Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics
• 
Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively

Compensation 
$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
 
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
 
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.
 
Hiring Process 
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.
 
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.
 
We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 
 
Please note that: 
• 
You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
• 
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• 
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
• 
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
• 
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete.
